evals.prompt: I have a Godot 3D horror scene reference of a contaminated hospital ward. Search for free hospital/medical props, plastic curtains, stretchers, carts, warning signs, and PBR materials that match the mood. Give me a ranked report only; do not download anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Inspects or infers project/style context, searches license-verifiable sources such as Sketchfab, OpenGameArt, Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, Quaternius, and itch.io, produces a ranked table with source URLs, formats, license, score breakdown, verdicts, risks, and Godot import notes, flags any prototype-only/release-blocked assets, and does not download without approval.

evals.prompt: Find me a free low-poly humanoid character plus idle/walk/run animations for a Godot prototype. I am okay with prototype-only assets if you clearly mark release risks.
evals.expected_output: Targets Quaternius, Mixamo, Kenney, OpenGameArt, Sketchfab, and itch.io as appropriate, verifies rig/animation/license details from original sources, ranks candidates using the 100-point rubric, caps non-commercial or ambiguous licenses at prototype_only with release_blocker warnings, includes Godot retargeting/import notes, and asks for explicit approval before download.

evals.prompt: Search for CC0 PBR materials and stylized 3D props for a Godot project. Prioritize GLB/GLTF, Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, and Quaternius. Include attribution/license manifest details for anything you recommend.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes CC0/provenance-safe sources, separates PBR materials from props, scores candidates for style, Godot compatibility, material/mesh quality, and integration cost, includes license and attribution fields suitable for third_party_asset_manifest.json, gives download paths only as proposed locations, and does not download during the scout report.
